title: 初次相识
concept: overly formal blank postcard/envelope with tiny bow tie
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art candidate for achievement_medal_postcards_tier_001, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but simple premium collectible postcard achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "初次相识" (first acquaintance). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and glossy warm teal enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE blank glossy postcard/envelope hybrid acting overly formal for a first meeting, wearing a tiny black bow tie and holding one tiny red flower-like seal on its corner. The blank postcard/envelope is the dominant shape; bow tie and tiny seal are secondary. Keep it low-tier and simple.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, deliberately silly but premium, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: very simple large readable silhouette, postcard/envelope centered and dominant, no extra mail clutter. Low detail enough for future postcard tiers to become wilder.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, awkwardly polite first-meeting comedy.
Color palette: ivory glossy postcard, saturated metallic gold rim, warm teal enamel, tiny black bow tie, small coral-red seal, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, smooth postcard surface, beveled rim, subtle hand-painted shading. No paper grain as the dominant texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no address lines, no stamp marks, no postmark rings, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no compass, no leaves, no suitcase, no shoes, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
